lightningL402.instructions: POST the quoted invoiceUrl to get invoice, paymentHash, l402Token and expiresAt; pay the invoice, then replay the original request with Authorization: L402 <token>:<preimage>. Quotes do not contain invoices or a WWW-Authenticate challenge.
